profile_text: With a strong focus on custom door manufacturing and installation, this Düsseldorf-based construction company has established itself as a specialist in its field, leveraging its in-house carpentry expertise to drive growth. A 100% increase in employees since its baseline reflects the company's successful expansion, driven by its ability to provide tailored solutions for residential clients. As a scaler in the construction sector, it continues to capitalize on demand for high-quality, bespoke door products.
